rows.en:
(Well, it's another nice day.
What should I do...)
(Oh, Nanase! What's she up to?)
Hey, Nanase. What are you doing out here?

Oh, \p-kun.
What a coincidence, running into you here.
I'm on my way to my part-time job at Nyan-Nyan.
Working on your day off? That's rough...

Not at all. At Nyan-Nyan, there's Ranka-sa...
Oh, I have to go! Sorryyy!
rows.notes: Both variants, Nanase, cutting herself off mid-name as in frd_nns_001 ("Ranka-sa...").

rows.en: Oh, good luck!
(Nanase and Ranka really are close...)

(Well, it's another nice day.
What should I do...)

Oh, \p-san.
What a coincidence, running into you here.

I see. Working on your day off?
That's rough...
Oh, good luck, okay!
(Nanase and Ranka-chan really are close...)

(Nice weather today.
Good thing we've got swimming class.)
Hey, Nanase. Nice weather today, huh?

It is...
That's kind of the problem...

Huh, really?
We've got swimming, so isn't nice weather better...?
Well, yes, but getting a tan and all is a bit...
Ah, I get it. For a girl, that makes sense...

Yes. If I get weird tan lines,
there are clothes I won't be able to wear...
Right, you've got a great figure, Nanase.
No, I mean...
Oh, um... Excuse me...
Huh? Wait...
(Uh-oh, did she get the wrong idea...?)

(Looks like nice weather today.
Good thing we've got swimming class~)
Oh, Nanase. Nice weather today, huh?

Huh, really?
We've got swimming, so isn't nice weather better...?
Oh, right, right. That's true...
Right, you've got such a great figure, Nanase.

Well, you know, you've got curves
in all the right places...
Huh? Hey, wait!
(Huh, what's with her?)
(Um, what was the next class again...)

Oh, I was just trying to remember
what our next class is...

Oh, the teacher for the next class got sick,
so it's a self-study period now.
Huh? Really?

Yes. Apparently the teacher got food poisoning
or something...
Yikes, that's awful...

That's what I heard, anyway.
So I'm thinking of going to the art room
to work on my assignment.
That's Nanase for you. Good luck.
(Well, I think I'll go take a nap on the roof...)
(Umm, what was the next class again...)

Yeah, I was just trying to remember
what our next class is...
Huh? Seriously?
Wow~, that's some bad luck.
That's Nanase for you. Good luck.
(Well, I think I'll go relax in the library...)
(Okay, it's lunchtime. I'm hungry.)

\p-kun,
where are you going for lunch?

Oh, Nanase.
Why do you ask?

Well, I'm hungry, but I can't come up
with any good ideas for what to eat...
I see. Actually, I haven't decided at all either...
What a dilemma, huh...
Yeah, really. What do we do...
Oh no, lunch break is almost over!

Oh, you're right.
How did we spend so long deciding...?

Good question...
I mean, I have to hurry! See you!
rows.notes: Both variants, Nanase. "sou desu ne... ja nakute" = agreeing, then catching herself.

rows.en: (Never thought it'd turn out like this...)
(Okay, lunchtime, huh. I'm hungry.)

\p-san,
where are you going for lunch?

Oh, Nanase.
How come you're asking?
I see. Actually, I haven't decided at all either...
Yeah, really. What do we do~...

Oh, you're right.
How did we spend so long deciding...?
(Who knew it'd turn out like this...)
